items.q: How much does camping cost at Caffrey Recreation Area?
items.a: RV and trailer sites are $52 per night regular, $58 weekend and $65 holiday. Tent sites are $40 regular, $46 weekend and $48 holiday. Every rate includes up to 4 people.

items.q: How much are extra guests?
items.a: Up to 4 additional guests can stay for $10 per guest per night, for a maximum of 8 guests per site. Children under 5 stay free.

items.q: How do I make a reservation?
items.a: Call (570) 226-4608 or email Reservations@caffreyrecreation.com with your dates, site type and number of guests. A one-night deposit holds your site, or three nights for holidays.

items.q: How much is the deposit?
items.a: Non-holiday reservations need a one-night deposit per site. Holiday reservations need a three-night deposit per site.

items.q: What is the cancellation policy?
items.a: Cancel 15 or more days before arrival for a refund minus a $25 administration fee. Cancellations within 14 days forfeit the deposit. There are no refunds for weather or early departures.

items.q: Will my price change if rates go up?
items.a: No. Reservations made before a price change keep their original price.

items.q: Are the campsites on the water?
items.a: Caffrey sits right on the west shore of Lake Wallenpaupack. Sites sit among tall trees a short walk from the docks, boat launch and waterfront picnic area.

items.q: What hookups do the sites have?
items.a: Every site has 30 amp electric and water, a picnic table and a fire ring. RV and trailer campers also get access to the dump station.

items.q: Can I bring a tent?
items.a: Yes. Tent sites allow up to 2 tents per site and include electric, water, a picnic table and a fire ring.

items.q: Are there showers and laundry?
items.a: Yes. Coin-operated showers and laundry are next to the camp store.

items.q: What does the camp store sell?
items.a: Basic camping and fishing supplies, firewood and ice cream.

items.q: Are pets allowed?
items.a: No. Pets are not allowed at Caffrey Recreation Area.

items.q: What time is check-in and check-out?
items.a: Check-in is 1 PM and check-out is 12 PM (noon). Campers who occupy a site before noon are charged an extra day, and sites must be set up before 11 PM.

items.q: Can I swim at Caffrey?
items.a: No. Swimming is not permitted at the campground or marina.

items.q: Is alcohol allowed?
items.a: No. Alcohol, smoking and vaping are not permitted at Caffrey.

items.q: What are the quiet hours?
items.a: Quiet hours are 10 PM to 7 AM daily.

items.q: Can I bring my own firewood?
items.a: No. Outside firewood isn't allowed because it can carry invasive pests. Firewood is sold at the Caffrey camp store.

items.q: How many vehicles can I bring?
items.a: Each site includes one camping unit and one vehicle. Additional vehicles park in a designated area for a fee.

items.q: Can I run an air conditioner or heater?
items.a: Water, 30 amp electric and the dump station are included, but electric is not provided for air conditioners or heaters.

items.q: Can I launch my boat at the campground?
items.a: Yes. Campers can store and launch a boat for $10 for their entire stay.

items.q: Can I keep my boat at my campsite?
items.a: No. Boats, jet skis and trailers must be registered with the campground and parked in the designated area, not at your site. Launching and storage are $10 for your whole stay.

items.q: Is there gas for boats?
items.a: Yes. Caffrey has an on-site gas dock on Lake Wallenpaupack.

items.q: Is there a pump-out station?
items.a: Yes. Boats must use the pump-out station at the dock to empty greywater and blackwater tanks.

items.q: Where can I buy or service a boat nearby?
items.a: Capri Marine, the full-service marina next door at 457 Lakeshore Drive, handles boat sales, service and storage.

items.q: Where is Caffrey Recreation Area?
items.a: 431 Lakeshore Drive, Lakeville, PA 18438, on the west shore of Lake Wallenpaupack in Wayne County, off Route 590 in the Pocono Mountains.

items.q: What are the office and store hours?
items.a: Thursday and Sunday 9 AM to 5 PM, Friday and Saturday 9 AM to 6 PM, closed Monday through Wednesday. Call ahead if bad weather is expected.

items.q: When is the camping season?
items.a: The season generally runs from late spring through mid-October. Call (570) 226-4608 to confirm this year's opening and closing dates.

items.q: How far is Lake Wallenpaupack from New York City and Philadelphia?
items.a: Lake Wallenpaupack is roughly a 2 to 2.5 hour drive from New York City and about 2.5 hours from Philadelphia, depending on traffic.
